comment:
* Implementation of the {@link SnapHelper} supporting pager style snapping in either vertical or * horizontal orientation. * *

* * PagerSnapHelper can help achieve a similar behavior to * {@link androidx.viewpager.widget.ViewPager}. Set both {@link RecyclerView} and the items of the * {@link RecyclerView.Adapter} to have * {@link android.view.ViewGroup.LayoutParams#MATCH_PARENT} height and width and then attach * PagerSnapHelper to the {@link RecyclerView} using {@link #attachToRecyclerView(RecyclerView)}.

variables.name: mVerticalHelper
variables.comment: Orientation helpers are lazily created per LayoutManager.
